feature: Align dogfood root AGENTS.md and catalog pointers with AGENTS.md onboarding model
problem: Root AGENTS.md and README/AGENTS catalogs omit template/adopt/bootstrap/nudge and the project-vs-session memory split.
proposed_solution: Light-touch updates to root AGENTS.md, README.md, and AGENTS.md skill catalog (and optional AGENTS/HARNESS docs pointers) naming the new pieces without rewriting root AGENTS.md into the consumer template.
acceptance_criteria: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; t=Path('AGENTS.md').read_text(); needles=['adopt-agents-md','agents-bootstrap','agents-md-nudge','templates/AGENTS']; assert all(n in t for n in needles), f'missing: {[n for n in needles if n not in t]}'"
rg -q 'agents-bootstrap' AGENTS.md && rg -q 'agents-bootstrap' README.md && rg -q 'adopt-agents-md|templates/AGENTS' README.md
python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; t=Path('AGENTS.md').read_text(); lo=t.lower(); assert 'project memory' in lo; assert 'session' in lo and ('.harness' in t or 'harness-context' in lo)"
! rg -q '^## Landmines' AGENTS.md && ! rg -q '^## Security considerations' AGENTS.md

python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; t=Path('AGENTS.md').read_text(); assert '## Commands' in t; assert 'make validate' in t or 'make eval-fast' in t; assert '## Harness' in t; assert '## Key artifacts' in t; assert '## Agents' in t; assert len(t.splitlines())<=120"

python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; t=Path('docs/HARNESS_ESSENCE.md').read_text(); lo=t.lower(); onboarding=sum(1 for n in ['adopt-agents-md','agents-bootstrap','agents-md-nudge','templates/AGENTS'] if n in t); assert onboarding>=2 or ('project memory' in lo and 'session' in lo and 'agents.md' in lo)"
edge_cases: Root AGENTS.md remains dogfood exemplar: has ## Harness; not byte-identical to library/cursor/templates/AGENTS.md; no consumer-template primary headings (## Landmines, ## Security considerations)
Do not remove existing harness/commands guidance (make validate/eval-fast still in ## Commands; Harness 5-bullet block retained)
No further product features beyond alignment — doc/catalog pointers only; no new scripts, hooks, or validate gates
README onboarding pointer names adopt/template path for consumers without duplicating full dogfood AGENTS.md body
verification_method: python3/rg structural checks on AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/HARNESS_ESSENCE.md; make eval-fast regression

decisions.reason: Was rg one-of-four; now requires all onboarding pieces (adopt, bootstrap skill, nudge hook, template path) named in root AGENTS.md
Added README adopt/template pointer — skills catalog alone is insufficient for consumer onboarding
Vacuous OR (title always matches AGENTS.md); now requires explicit project memory prose plus session/.harness or harness-context contrast
Added consumer-template heading guard (## Security considerations) alongside ## Landmines ban
Added ## Key artifacts + ## Agents retention asserts — light-touch, not template swap
Was vacuous OR on any AGENTS.md mention; now ≥2 onboarding needles or explicit project/session memory split in HARNESS_ESSENCE
